newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzanian shilling gains on dollar, falls on pound.
newsitem.headline: Tanzanian shilling gains on dollar, falls on pound.

text.p: The Tanzanian shilling gained on the dollar but fell against the pound on Friday.

On the dollar, the shilling rallied to exchange at a mean rate of 623.7000 compared to Thursday's 624.1059. Last Friday, the shilling exchanged for 624.6900 to the dollar recovering ground after almost one month of depreciation.
The shilling lost value against pound, exchanging at a mean rate of 1028.0151 compared to Thursday's 1022.6007.
Volatility in the shilling-pound exchange rate is due to sterling being seldom used in the local market, dealers said.
Finance Minister Daniel Yona told parliament in his state 1997/98 budget on Thursday that the preferred trading band for the shilling against the dollar was between 605 and 620.
The budget was characterised by a broadening of the tax base and a promise of continuing tight fiscal policies, news which has been generally welcomed by the market, dealers said.
